theory.heading: What Azure Blueprints is
theory.body: Azure Blueprints describes the methods and patterns used within Azure Administrator (AZ-104) to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why Azure Blueprints matters
theory.body: Without Azure Blueprints, systems built with Azure Administrator (AZ-104) are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Azure Blueprints works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Azure Blueprints follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Azure Blueprints.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Azure Blueprints
theory.body: Azure Blueprints offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
